headline: An AI-made video of South Africa rugby coach Rassie Erasmus singing to the World Cup trophy in a movie spoof is spreading online.
score_reason: Light viral item with no news consequence.
importance_line: Nothing material changed; it is a harmless example of AI face-swap parody of a public figure, and the article itself calls the clip fake.
summary: South Africa's Daily Voice reports that an AI-generated video places Springboks coach Rassie Erasmus in the 'White Chicks' car-singing scene, belting out 'A Thousand Miles' to the Webb Ellis Cup, and calls it undeniably artificial. It spreads just after the Springboks' 42-38 loss to Australia in Perth.
